Reference acknowledgements

Native projects are referenced for simulation values and mechanics; their engines are not browser dependencies.

RocketSim — https://github.com/ZealanL/RocketSim
RLBot-Beast — https://github.com/NicEastvillage/RLBot-Beast
rl_ball_sym — https://github.com/VirxEC/rl_ball_sym
RocketGPU — https://github.com/thecosmicskye/RocketGPU

The corresponding MIT licenses are retained beside this file.
Reference data: https://rl.source.gs/physics/ and https://rl.source.gs/items/bodies/fennec/
Figures are attributed in the research notes. No wholesale item catalogue or proprietary asset pack is bundled.
